## Summary

As an Open Source Software Development Intern, they develop public, reusable R packages that make civic open data easier to access, analyze, and use, contributing to the Lab’s broader effort to expand access to open government data across cities.

Learn more about the internship [here](../internships/software-internship.qmd).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Contributions to the Lab

Shelby has contributed to the expansion of the [**OpenData R package ecosystem**](../projects.qmd#sec-package-ecosystem), developing many packages using the Lab's *OpenData Package Developer's Guide*. Their work has expanded the ecosystem across additional cities and states while demonstrating how the Lab's standardized framework can be used to develop reproducible, publicly available open-data tools.
